programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Starring Ti Lung, this seafaring tale of a daring 'Robin Hood' of the deep is directed by the godfather of kung fu films Chang Cheh, Wu Ma and Pao Hsueh-li.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chin Han return with a Huangmei Opera classic, depicting a loving couple whose marriage is being poisoned by the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: In this lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, two cardsharks spar in a battle of wits and fists to become king of the casino.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: A magic solar baby who's sent to Earth by a benevolent god grows up to have superpowers but loses them during solar eclipses.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: This splendid, award-winning film features Li Li Hua as the Empress Wu Tse-tien, the most powerful woman in China's four thousand year history.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns to find his ruthless brother has taken over the family business and imprisoned their sister. Now, Hu and his sister must fight to get their lives back.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: In this adapation of a Qiong Yao novel, a young woman finds lust, trouble, and, finally, happiness at a picturesque farm.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chang Cheh presents this ultimate depiction of dysfunctional kung fu masters, overcoming their shortcomings to win the day, one corpse at a time.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: In this twist-filled action film, a country girl is saved by a hero and remains coveted by her jilted lover.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers' directors created this 60's classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: A young man and his sifu earn a living as pseudo-ghost catchers until his sifu is arrested and an honest gal becomes his new companion.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Set in the Warring States period of ancient China, this drama tells the story of Nieh Cheng, one of history's greatest political assassins.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A young couple lived happily in a house but the woman becomes haunted after she accidentally kills her husband.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: In this mind-blowing sequel to the Shaw Brothers' horror hit, zombies run amok, driving doctors to seek a natural cause while the actual one may be supernatural.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Go on a courageous quest with Hsiao Feng-ling and her classmate, as they try to capture the lute demon Chin Mo and send him back to the netherworld.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: Choreographed by Tang Chia, this film is an entertaining combination of eye-popping martial arts' moves and thrilling 'Sherlock Holmes' investigations. Stars Liu Yu Pu, Derek Yee.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friend's fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: A grateful convict becomes his prison officer's defender after he learns that the officer's restaurant has been taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: In this twisted comedy, a gambling game between a rookie con artist and an experienced flimflam man has life or death repercussions.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: The chase may be long, but the action is fast and furious, in this tale of a dart master-for-hire and the innkeeper's daughter who loves him.

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: This Yuan Dynasty tale tells of the Sacred Fire sect, Wu Tang clan, O Mei's disciples, a sacred book, and the destruction of Shaolin.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Families win and lose fortunes overnight while neighbours swindle each other as stock as speculation madness takes over Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: When Lung, the Black Enforcer, is forced to house a killer named Fei during a snowstorm, Fei's gang comes for him. Fei kills Lung's mother and sister, triggering a fearsome vendetta.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman (David Chiang) is moved to fight back after the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by a gang.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: This comedy centres on the residents of a females-only apartment who hail from different backgrounds and make money in varied ways.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: A virtuous lone swordsman who is not without individual weaknesses (Ti Lung) finally decides that it's payback time.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: This drama centres on the seductive Judy. A woman with a rich husband, she also has two lovers who happen to be brothers!

programme.title: Lady With a Sword
programme.desc: Director Kao Pao Shu casts Shaw's darling Lily Ho as the embittered swordswoman searching for the man who murdered her sister.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: A wanna-be-detective/swordsman gets more than he bargained for when investigating the disappearance of some martial artists.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: Three women and three men beguile, blackmail, bicker and backstab each other all the way to a shocking surprise ending.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A village's dedicated chief constable falls in love with the blind daughter of a havoc-wreaking bandit.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: In Wong Jing's first modern drama spiced up by three great kung fu choreographers, stars Ti Lung, Chen Hui Min, Wang Lung Wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu defy death.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: Wang Yu heads this film's stellar cast under martial arts master, Chang Cheh. Together, they present beautifully choreographed action scenes.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Directed by Chang Cheh and starring Ti Lung in his first main role, this drama depicts how two lovers contend with family opposition and an unjust accusation.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Daring Sung Dynasty must fight their way out of trap after trap and band together to save the prime minister.

programme.title: Killers on Wheels
programme.desc: While taking a ferry on the way to a vacation, Kwok and his family meet a road thug who puts an ugly spin on their holiday plans.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: As a young clan member rises to helm the Dragon gang after his foster father's death, an incriminating letter changes everything. Can he fight the tide?

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Alexander Fu stars as a young carriage driver who finds love and encounters peril after he rescues a girl from being harassed by a dangerous group.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: What starts off as a musical romp turns into something more akin to a Shakespearean tragedy than a beach-babe party. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: Disciples of Shaolin
programme.desc: One of Chang Cheh's finest films, this saga stars Alexander Fu Sheng in his greatest martial arts role as a penniless country boy who fights his way to riches.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: Controversial director Chu Yuan combines stars to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women expect of it.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: This martial arts drama centres on the Thirteen Eagles Assassination Sect of the infamous Iron Boat Clan. Starring Ti Lung, Fu Sheng.

programme.title: Love Without End (1970)
programme.desc: This shot-in-colour remake of the classic black-and-white drama has Jenny Hu in the tragic role made famous by Linda Lin Dai.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: After the emperor's seal is stolen, 'The Rat' and 'The Cat's' squabble for martial arts supremacy is put on hold for a time.

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This abourer and complex adaptation of a popular wuxia novel contains conspiracies, stratagems, and sword fights aplenty.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: This three-film anthology collectively offers up a captivating examination of human obsession and love.

programme.title: Temple of the Red Lotus
programme.desc: When the family that a man named Wu (Jimmy Wang Yu) marries into comes under repeated attack, he suspects that his in-laws are bandits.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: After a master passes on his magical weapon to his top student, a jealous rival goes and kidnaps the man's fiance.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: Go on a quest with the Monkey King, Goddess of Mercy and Dragon Girl, as they battle Hung, the son of the Ox Demon to save Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim.

programme.title: Love Without End (1961)
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan, capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: Director Chor Yuen reunites with novelist, Gu Long, and superstar, Ti Lung, in this exciting sequel to Clans of Intrigue.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber(1961)
programme.desc: With a focus on the pampered teenaged Jia Bao Yu, believed to be of supernatural origins, this Chinese classic depicts the Jia family's rise and fall.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Starring Chin Han, Wang Ping and Tsung Hua, this movie revolves around the challenges that beset three sworn brothers and sisters.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: Clan of the White Lotus
programme.desc: A hero (Gordon Liu Chia hui) must learn 'Embroidery Fist' and acupuncture to counter a villain's (Lo Lieh) deadly fight techniques.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: This intriguing action flick blends westerns and detective films in its martial arts mainline, depicting a tale of vigilante justice versus the law.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: A pillar of the Qing establishment kills his blood brother to steal the man's wife. Also starring David Chiang.

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chin Han return with a Huangmei Opera classic, depicting a loving couple whose marriage is being poisoned by the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: Duel for Gold
programme.desc: Famed director Chor Yuen has three pairs of cunning crooks on a quest to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House but one is undercover.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: In this lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, two cardsharks spar in a battle of wits and fists to become king of the casino.

programme.title: Let's Fall in Love
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his father's business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one?

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Share the adventures of patriot Chu Tieh-hsieh and his three comrades, who head out with the aim of 'relieving' Mongolian invaders of their ill-gotten gains.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: 3 beautiful salesgirls masquerade as high society belles in a bid to realize their dreams of marrying millionaires.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: In this 'Brave Archer' sequel, Kuo Tsing's (Alexander Fu Sheng) love for Huang Yung (Niu Niu) is challenged by Ouyang Fung.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: When a bag of jewels falls from the sky, that's just the start of Ah Niu's misadventures involving a brothel, a disastrous wedding night and the cops!

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chang Yi play a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge against the 4 outlaws who murdered her parents when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman to kill them.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: In this twist-filled action film, a country girl is saved by a hero and remains coveted by her jilted lover.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: This wuxia film's swordsman hero must go against many treacherous warriors to solve the murder of three clan heads.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: After a kidnapped swordsman is surprisingly rescued by the father he had been looking for, he also learns about his mother from him.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: A waitress, who is secretly the outlaw Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor but picking the wrong targets sets the law on her heels.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The Emperor develops a more deadly Flying Guillotine and trains a squad of women to combat the 'Iron Umbrella' and a band of rebels.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: A hothead (Wang Chung) is tempted by the dark side in this coming-of-age tale which centres on c. 1970s lower-class Hong Kong teens.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: This action-packed adventure centres on a mysterious masked highwayman who not only steals from the rich but also blinds them!

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: A poor young woman becomes a popular bargirl in Hong Kong's gritty response to Hollywood's The World of Suzie Wong.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin loyalists (led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai) go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.
